title: Multimodal Injury Risk Prediction in Tennis
abstract: arXiv:2608.25126v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Machine learning has had a significant positive impact on the prediction of athlete performance and injury risk. Most works in this field rely on subjective observations and expert assessments, which restrict their effectiveness. In sports like soccer, basketball, and wrestling, some studies attempt to address this challenge by integrating data from alternative sources, such as readings from wearable devices, alongside traditional subjective observations and expert assessments to enhance accuracy. However, similar research in tennis remains largely unexplored. In this paper, we propose a multimodal Predictive Athlete Readiness framework for Tennis (PART) to assess both performance and injury risk in tennis players. By leveraging machine learning and deep learning techniques, PART processes multiple sources of data collected from nine collegiate tennis players, including physiological metrics, training and match data, sleep data from wear

translated_title: 网球多模态损伤风险预测
translated_abstract: 摘要：机器学习在运动员表现和损伤风险预测方面已产生显著的积极影响。该领域的大多数工作依赖于主观观察和专家评估，这限制了其有效性。在足球、篮球和摔跤等运动中，一些研究尝试通过整合替代数据源（如可穿戴设备的读数）与传统主观观察和专家评估相结合，以提升准确性，从而应对这一挑战。然而，类似的研究在网球领域仍基本未探索。在本文中，我们提出了一种用于网球的多模态预测运动员准备度框架（PART），旨在评估网球运动员的表现和损伤风险。通过利用机器学习和深度学习技术，PART处理来自九名大学网球运动员收集的多源数据，包括生理指标、训练和比赛数据，以及来自可穿戴设备的睡眠数据。
tldr: 本文首次提出一个多模态框架PART，结合生理、训练和睡眠等多源数据，利用机器学习和深度学习来预测网球运动员的表现与损伤风险，填补了该领域研究空白。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the first multimodal framework PART that integrates physiological, training, and sleep data using machine and deep learning to predict tennis players' performance and injury risk, filling a research gap in this domain.
